policy_prompt_for_memory.description: If the memory carried in holds a value, copy it unchanged. If it is empty (first step, demonstration shown): first read the goal instruction and note whether it says 'right before' or 'right after' the button was pressed. Then in the demonstration steps find the press: the first frame with fingers 0% open where the gripper is low (height under 0.08) over the button and the button's y jumps a few pixels. List the placements: frames where the fingers go from ~46% to at least ~95% open with height under 0.05 and the cube in that frame lies within about 8 pixels of a listed target (a release with no target within about 10 pixels of the cube is a drop on bare table; ignore it). For 'before', take the last placement earlier than the press; for 'after', take the first placement later than the press. Among the target entries in the execution scene at the bottom of this step, write the [y, x] of the one nearest the cube's resting position at that placement. e.g. [86, 100]

edits.modify_to: within about 6 pixels of goal_target; from that step on write 'yes'

annotator_prompt.description: The [y, x] of the target that the goal instruction designates: the goal asks for the target the demonstration placed the cube on either 'right before' or 'right after' the button was pressed. Found by reading the whole demonstration. The press is the first demonstration frame where the fingers read 0% open and the gripper is low (height under 0.08) over the button, with the button's listed y shifting a few pixels. A placement is a frame where the fingers widen from ~46% to at least ~95% with gripper height under 0.05 and the cube comes to rest within about 8 pixels of a listed target; a release with no listed target within about 10 pixels of the cube's resting position is a drop on bare table and is not a placement. If the goal says 'before', take the last placement preceding the press frame; if it says 'after', take the first placement following the press frame. The field holds the [y, x] of the target entry in the scene at the start of execution nearest to that placement's cube resting position. Written at the first decision step and never changed afterwards. e.g. [86, 100]
